title: Vulkanium
body:
# Vulkanium
Lightweight optimization modpack based on [**Performium Reborn**](https://modrinth.com/modpack/performium-reborn) but with [**VulkanMod**](https://modrinth.com/mod/vulkanmod ), trying to replicate the ecosystem of [**Sodium**](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), without Sodium. Especially useful on a potato PC

✅ Сompletely replaces

⚠️ Partially replaces

❌ No replaces

## Replacement progress
✅ [**Sodium**](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) —> [**VulkanMod**](https://modrinth.com/mod/vulkanmod) / [**VulkanModNeoForge**](https://modrinth.com/project/KUUY100B) / [**Xeno**](https://modrinth.com/mod/xeno)

✅ [**Sodium Extra**](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra) —> [**Not Enough Vulkan**](https://modrinth.com/mod/iuZL1bXB) / [**VulkanMod Extra**](https://modrinth.com/mod/vulkanmod-extra)

⚠️ [**Iris Shaders**](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) —> [**Beryl**](https://modrinth.com/mod/beryl) / [**VulkShade**](https://modrinth.com/mod/vulkshade)

✅ [**Bobby**](https://modrinth.com/mod/M08ruV16) —> [**VulkanBobby**](https://modrinth.com/mod/i9PLM1kH) & [**Bobby**](https://modrinth.com/mod/M08ruV16)

❌ [**voxy**](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxy)

❌ [**Distant Horizons**](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons)

- **Alpha** — Only VulkanMod itself is available for the desired version, but there are no shaders, etc
- **Beta** — In addition to the renderer, there are shaders or a Sodium Extra-like mod
- **Release** — Everything included

Some releases are available in multiple variants with different mod combinations. This is because certain Vulkan-related mods are incompatible with each other and cannot be used together. The suffix in the version name indicates which variant is included (e.g. 4.3-VulkShade or 4.3-Not Enough Vulkan), so you can choose the one that best fits your needs
